issue.title: Telemetry rates: set_rate_rc unsupported
issue.body:
On Ardupilot, I need to set the telemetry rates myself or I don't get any updates. This works for battery and GPS, for instance.

set_rate_rc is not implemented, I guess because it is already sent with system status. However I don't get any updates there unless I open QGroundControl and then come back to my app.

I guess this is more of a list of questions:

- How does a GCS make the rc connection status start working?
- How do I get the connection strength percentage? It is always NaN
- I don't really want to change the rates that are configured in parameters on the autopilot. Is there a way to set the rate to the value configured on the autopilot? Or do I need to fetch the parameter and then set it to that value with set_rate_* ? In that case, how do I know which parameter to check (i.e. which telemetry port: for ArduPilot x in SRx_*)?

I'm now getting  `COMMAND_DENIED: Command Denied` with telemetry.setRateAltitude(1.0)

StatusText from telemetry has:

> INFO No ap_message for mavlink id (141)

I guess this means Ardupilot doesn't support the "ALTITUDE" MAVLINK message. https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/issues/6317 . This is a bit unexpected. The issue suggests there are other messages that contain the alititude. Which ones?

Again, working fine with PX4
I can't help much there, unfortunately, but I wanted to thank you for looking into that! Always happy to get contributions improving Ardupilot support 😊
Haha that was not the answer I was hoping for but fair enough, I'll try to figure it out and maybe contribute something back :)

Did you try asking on the Ardupilot Discord? I know that some people are using MAVSDK with Ardupilot (they contributed the support we have now) and they may be able to help you. They probably won't see this issue here, so it's probably worth linking it on their Discord 👍.

- For the altitude, I got it from telemetry.position
- For the speed, the ODOMETRY message is also not supported by ArduPilot. Instead I got it from telemetry.velocityNed - I just needed the sqrt of the three components so that should be fine too
- still outstanding for me: the RC connection status question

@JonasVautherin I will try the discord, thanks for the suggestion!

After https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/commit/e2b815e29d2cf6bc6823aa9d3d02d3dc0019123a, there is a workaround by just calling set_rate_health (which will also set the SYS_STATUS rate).

I think we should have a `set_rate_sys_status` and get rid of the `health` and `rc_status` ones. Or just have both do the same thing but that could be confusing for users.

Could we at least add a comment for now to make it less confusing?

And then longer term, I agree, we should improve it. Maybe combine them into health?

issue.title: Implement set_rate_rc for ArduPilot via SYS_STATUS

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
## Summary
- Implement `set_rate_rc_status()` which previously returned `Unsupported` unconditionally
- ArduPilot: request `SYS_STATUS` at the desired rate (RC info comes via SYS_STATUS)
- PX4: request `RC_CHANNELS` at the desired rate, plus `SYS_STATUS`
- Handle shared `SYS_STATUS` rate between health and RC by taking the max of both

## Motivation
Fixes #2516 — On ArduPilot, RC link status is delivered via `SYS_STATUS` rather than a dedicated stream. `set_rate_rc` was not implemented because of this, so users got no RC updates unless another GCS opened first.

## Changes
- **telemetry_impl.h**: Add `_health_rate_hz`, `_rc_status_rate_hz` members and `set_rate_sys_status()` helper
- **telemetry_impl.cpp**: 
  - `set_rate_rc_status()`: ArduPilot requests SYS_STATUS, PX4 requests RC_CHANNELS + SYS_STATUS
  - `set_rate_health()`: Now uses shared rate logic via `set_rate_sys_status()`
  - Async versions updated with same logic

## Test Results
- [x] Build clean (Debug, zero errors/warnings)
- [x] Unit tests 289/289 pass
- [x] System tests (3/3 pass): RcStatusViaSysStatus, RcStatusViaRcChannels, RcStatusUnavailableViaSysStatus
- [x] PX4 SITL: `set_rate_rc_status(1.0)` returns **Success**, 3 RC updates received at ~1 Hz
- [x] ArduPilot path covered by RcStatusViaSysStatus test (SYS_STATUS with RC sensor flags)
